summary: Defines the Segment Routing Header (SRH), a new IPv6 routing extension header used to apply Segment Routing to the IPv6 data plane. It describes the header and how SR-capable nodes process it to steer packets along a list of segments.

eli5.summary: A package carries a list of stops it must visit. This is the label on the package that holds that list and tells each stop where to send it next.
